# Simulated Sensor RAW DNG / JPEG acceptance pair

These are Photivra-owned, independently authored 64×64 grayscale-ramp serializer
fixtures, generated by `scripts/generate-photographic-export-fixtures.mjs` at
engine API 0.100.0. The ramp is synthetic post-ADC site-code data, not measured
sensor calibration, a processed RGB image masked as RAW, or evidence of an
authoritative physical capture producer. Both files carry the same capture ID
and simulation hash; document/instance IDs are distinct.

| File | Bytes | SHA-256 |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| photivra-chart.dng | 10608 | f7506f44572f5936006326049fb7ff7705980482014de496dac190e80dffa1f4 |
| photivra-chart.jpg | 3596 | 37e6f24af4dfbbf384926d59d29ee1367aaeef101d62381c7c8540dc115a3b25 |

Local independent results: Pillow reads TIFF tags/exact uncompressed RAW codes
and decodes JPEG/EXIF; DOM/Expat and lxml/libxml2 agree on XMP RDF attributes;
LibRaw 0.21.2 opens, unpacks and processes the DNG (64×64 native, white 1023).
These do not certify Adobe compatibility or physical sensor calibration.

External acceptance:

1. Download both files and open the DNG in Adobe Camera Raw/Lightroom and an
   open RAW editor. Record application/version, successful decoding, 64×64
   dimensions, Photivra virtual identity, absence of unsupported-format errors
   and usable rendering controls. Do not require pixel-identical rendering from
   different demosaic/tone algorithms. No physical photograph is implied.
2. Inspect metadata with an independent XMP/EXIF reader: shared capture/hash,
   distinct artifact IDs, no GPS/serial/private-path data, truthful digitalCreation
   classification. Compare exposure, crop and orientation with the JPEG.
3. Review PR #169 source, assumptions, provenance and limitations before DCO
   certification. The full frame is limited to 4,096 sites; no resampling or
   typical-resolution/production-origin claim is made.

This is the historical serializer-only acceptance checkpoint. Reviewed producer-derived acceptance and owner Adobe/editor/browser evidence later merged in PR #201 and closed #16; see the current export acceptance guide. These original ramp files do not by themselves establish producer origin or additional Adobe tests.
